integrity: Proof uses explicit invariant reduction, common Fourier splitting, Jensen logarithmic average, and strict positivity. A standalone symbolic and numerical diagnostic script is embedded; numeric testing does not establish continuum claims. Literature-index coverage is incomplete.
scientific_limitations: Only the ergodic invariant diagonal arcsine measure at R=3 is analyzed, with alpha,beta>0. No off-diagonal attractor, physical basin, uniform hyperbolicity, or global boundedness is asserted. Positive transverse exponents are typical infinitesimal growth; the known symmetric one-parameter formula is excluded from the novel portion. Independent validation has not been performed.
title: Exact asymmetric transverse Lyapunov spectrum and a square-root instability cusp in a cyclic Lotka–Volterra map
